claims.claim: tiene por objeto seguir haciendo efectivo el derecho a una remuneración equitativa y suficiente
... cerca del 60 % del salario medio, y garantizar la capacidad adquisitiva frente al coste de la vida
claims.note: capacidad adquisitiva verified; 'cerca del 60 %' not in decree (CEDS threshold of 60 %, no claim that the SMI is near it)
no A/B ex-post source on the stated goal for 2021; AIReF 2025 DT p. 6 analyses only 2019 and 2023; AIReF Estudio 1/2026 cuadro 4 p. 29 covers 2019, 2023, 2024 only

claims.claim: AIReF 2025 p. 6: descensos transitorios del SMI real en 2021 y 2022

claims.note: figures and quote are exactly those of Table 2, p. 13; ratio = Real SMI / Real Mean Wage columns; source labelled as preprint

claims.claim: preprint Table 2 Kaitz series is fit to publish as before/after
claims.note: Not reliable enough to publish. Table 2 says columns are constant 2019 euros deflated by national CPI, but the SMI column cannot be: 2021 real 14.073 > nominal max 13.510 (965x14) with positive inflation; 2023 real 14.078 vs nominal 15.120 implies deflator 0,93 vs CPI 2019-2023 ~0,87; so the ratio cannot be reproduced and may mix inconsistent deflators. Level (60-64 %) and the 2021->2022 direction (preprint -1,3 pts) differ from the official Eurostat series (minimum wage as % of mean gross monthly earnings, B-S): 2019 45,6, 2020 49,6, 2021 47,5, 2022 47,6, 2023 49,1, 2024 50,0, 2025 51,9.

corrections: stated_goal: 'cerca del 60 % del salario medio' is not in the decree; it says the right is 'en línea con lo establecido por el Comité Europeo de Derechos Sociales que ha interpretado que dicho umbral se sitúa en el 60 % del salario medio'. Write: 'en línea con el umbral del 60 % del salario medio que fija el Comité Europeo de Derechos Sociales'
